mapper.select: select id, message_id as messageId, action_instance_id as actionInstanceId, consumer_group as consumerGroup, consume_status as consumeStatus, dedupe_key as dedupeKey, attempt_count as attemptCount, last_error_message as lastErrorMessage, version, first_received_at as firstReceivedAt, last_received_at as lastReceivedAt, updated_at as updatedAt from action_consume_log where message_id = #{messageId}
